title: Incorporating Human Explanations for Robust Hate Speech Detection
findings: The paper's primary findings are on a method to improve the robustness of hate speech detection models. While the underlying dataset (Social Bias Frames) includes hate speech targeting religious groups (specifically, 5% of hate speech tweets targeted Jewish people and 4% targeted Muslims), the paper does not offer specific findings or performance breakdowns related to religion. The inclusion of these groups is part of a broader analysis of hate speech against various demographics.
